name: Haunted Coop

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 25 Nature check to recognize the unquiet animal spirits and soothe them, allowing the spirits to disperse
reset: The haunted coop resets 1d4 rounds after it's triggered.

items.name: The Pigeons! The Pigeons!
items.text:
Trigger A person attempts to open the coop, searches the mounds within, or causes damage to it

---
Effect A sudden blast of shadowy pigeons emerges from the coop, shrieking and flapping into the face of the triggering creature anywhere they might be in the room. That creature must attempt a DC 27 Will save save with the following results.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to these haunts for 24 hours.

Success The creature becomes Frightened 1, and this frightened condition can't be reduced below 1 as long as they remain in area B2a.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2 and convinced that the pigeons are harbingers of a greater doom awaiting them. They cannot reduce their frightened condition below 1 for 24 hours.

Critical Failure As failure, but with an unlimited duration.

text: A sudden flurry of shadowy pigeons erupts into a frenzy and breaks out of the coop.
